verdict.rationale: Asana's docs list official client libraries for JavaScript and Python. A v3 Node SDK migration guide documents SDK features such as `nextPage` pagination. Asana also publishes an official OpenAPI spec repo and a documented deprecation process, both of which support building against the SDKs. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript and Python, in-depth evidence of SDK feature coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
